answer: Randomized Lagoon Assignment. Each epoch, a public beacon draws a fresh permutation assigning agents to lagoon partitions; assignments commit only after the tide of the beacon, so attackers cannot precompute placements. Enforcement: the nadir partition, chosen at random each round, is audited fully, and duplicate agents there are removed with all rewards forfeited. An attacker must spread identities across all partitions and survive a random full audit, paying roughly 1/partition-count expected forfeiture per identity.
